_comment: Corrections against extracted traces and segments. A correction NEVER silently rewrites data. It records a claim, who made it, what evidence supports it, and what would resolve it. Downstream steps read the status and decide; the disagreement stays visible in the record.

_kinds.trace_segment: disputes a span of turns within one source's trace
_kinds.segment: a claim about a road segment in the consensus, independent of any single source

disputed_segment.claim: route continues north from baycrest to heron road, west along heron, south down sandalwood, back to baycrest

asserted_instead.claim: the route Zaid drove stays on baycrest to the traffic light, turns left onto walkley, and returns to the test centre

resolution.detail: Recorded originally as 'disputed', which overstated the claim. Zaid clarified the leg is absent from the route he personally drove and made no claim about routes 2 and 3. OCR across nine Walkley G2 videos subsequently read sandalwood in three of them (sHE72JmAGOA, bVM4POE00a4, MKTsaqTxhQk) and heron in three. The leg appears to be real on a route Zaid has not driven.
resolution.lesson: When the scope of a correction is unclear, record the narrow version. Local knowledge is the most valuable and least verifiable input this project has; a broad correction that turns out wrong contaminates everything downstream.

corrections.notes: Route numbers are per-author labels, not identifiers. Zaid has observed that what jt7gwng calls route 2 matches the route he knows as route 1. Corrections must attach to a turn span, never a route number.

target.junction_note: signalised intersection where Walkley Road meets both Albion Road N and Colliston Crescent

claim_in_data.detail: Highest video support of any segment in the corpus. Would otherwise render as a high-confidence part of the route.

asserted_instead.claim: the route does not turn onto Colliston Crescent; it passes straight through the intersection

reporter.note: project owner, from direct knowledge of the route

evidence.detail: Dashcam frame shows overhead mast signs reading 'Colliston' on the left and 'Albion N' on the right at a signalised intersection. The vehicle proceeds straight. Both names are legible from the approach regardless of which way the car turns.
why_pipeline_cannot_detect: junction validation passes: the junction is real and the route traverses it
duration filtering passes: the sign is visible for a normal approach duration
fuzzy-match checks pass: the OCR read is exactly correct, confirmed by an exact-match run with no fuzzy fallback
support thresholds pass: 7 authors and 15 mentions clear any realistic bar
closed-walk constraints pass: it is a valid edge at a node the route uses

corrections.why_the_rule_did_not_fire: The drive-past rule flags a video-only segment when another segment at the same junction has text corroboration. 'albion x walkley' has 0 text authors. reddit:qrwxz3 is the only text trace in the corpus mentioning albion, colliston, kitchener or jasper, so no text source describes this junction at all. The rule is correct and has no evidence to act on.
corrections.resolves_when: a text source describes the Walkley/Albion junction, at which point the drive-past rule should reach this verdict without manual correction. Reclassifying reddit:qrwxz3 may supply it.
